method: Drivers of the largest 2025 moves (quarter-start cap >= $150M), researched from news and filings on Nov 24 2026. Same shape as retro-data.json quarters.

drv.note: ROSELLA Ph3 of relacorilant plus nab-paclitaxel in platinum-resistant ovarian cancer met its PFS primary endpoint (Mar 31); shares more than doubled that day.
Recorlev revenue up ~141% y/y and total revenue up 48%, with positive adjusted EBITDA; guidance raised.
Preclinical obesity antibody pipeline drew momentum buying; hit a 52-week high in late February (microcap, no clinical data).
Navacaprant failed the KOASTAL-1 Ph3 in depression on primary and secondary endpoints (Jan 2); shares fell ~80% in a day.
BEACON-IPF Ph2b/3 of bexotegrast paused on a DSMB recommendation (Feb 7), then stopped in March over an imbalance in IPF-related adverse events.
Discontinued the Ph1 of lead oral PTH1R agonist SEP-786 after two grade 3 bilirubin elevations (Feb 18); stock fell ~60%, four months after its IPO.
Cash fell to $57M with a dilutive PIPE in February while looking to out-license; stock down ~73% year to date by mid-March.
Licensed ex-China rights to RemeGen’s telitacicept (approved in China; global Ph3 in myasthenia gravis) with a $175M PIPE and a new CEO, after cutting 95% of staff; a sub-$1 shell re-rated overnight.
Licensed obesity drug LX9851 to Novo Nordisk ($45M upfront, up to $1B in milestones), turning the quarter profitable.
Ran up into the Aug 15 PDUFA for TNX-102 SL in fibromyalgia, later approved as Tonmya, the first new fibromyalgia drug in 15+ years.
Aerovate (a failed-asset cash shell) did a 1-for-35 reverse split and merged with private Jade Biosciences on Apr 28; the quarterly return reflects the reverse merger, not a readout.
Delisted to the OTC with a ~$5M market cap before a 1-for-75 reverse split in August to relist; the move reflects distress, not data.
Obefazimod met the primary endpoint in both ABTECT Ph3 induction trials in ulcerative colitis (Jul 22; 50 mg pbo-adj remission 19.3% and 13.4%); shares rose ~586% in a day.
June IPO at $7.50 with a small float; shares climbed to ~$65 on Ph2 enrollment news in September, then fell when the lock-up expired in December.
Strong Ph1b APEX data for KSI-101 in macular edema (over half of patients gained 15+ letters) and faster Ph3 enrollment re-rated all three late-stage programs.
Efzofitimod missed the primary endpoint (steroid reduction at week 48) in the EFZO-FIT Ph3 in pulmonary sarcoidosis (Sep 15); shares fell ~83% to about cash.
Sonelokimab missed significance in VELA-2 (placebo response 25.6%) in hidradenitis suppurativa (Sep 28); shares fell ~89% from a $3.9B cap.
Ulixacaltamide met primary endpoints in both Essential3 Ph3 studies in essential tremor (Oct 16), the first positive Ph3 program in ET; shares rose ~250% in a week.
Sold zaltenibart (MASP-3 inhibitor) to Novo Nordisk for up to $2.1B (Oct 15), its largest one-day gain ever; narsoplimab was approved in December.
Lock-up expiry in December brought heavy selling into a thinly traded, low-float post-IPO stock.
STAT3 inhibitor TTI-101 failed the Ph2 REVERT trial in IPF, with ~60% dropouts on drug vs 10% on placebo (Oct 13); shares fell ~85%.
RNA editor KRRO-110 in AATD produced far less functional protein than projected (Nov 12); the company dropped it, cut 34% of staff and Novo paused a deal; shares fell ~80%.
